announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~58%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~20% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.9%) and Broodscale still converting (3 of the Nov 10 Challenge top 8 incl. the win, 2 of 8 at German Nationals; Spellslinger rates Broodscale Bloodchief S-tier for top-8 conversion), -12 for organic correction (Spellslinger: mono-green Broodscale share down from 10.7% to 6.4%, effective archetypes steady near 32; Broodscale won none of the last three RCs). Goldfish and Spellslinger disagree on the trend, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Emrakul, the Promised End or Blade of the Bloodchief are the narrower enablers and the consensus pick; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 20% of all Modern decks, which WotC avoids hitting.
#40 Legacy staple in ~12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. The deck is still the most played (Eldrazi Ramp 11.9% on MTGGoldfish, Broodscale Bloodchief 13% on MTGTop8) and swept the Nov 10 Challenge, but Spellslinger shows its share falling and it won none of the last three Regional Championships, so a Nov 30 hit is about a coin flip. If WotC acts, Emrakul or Blade of the Bloodchief is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 588 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 13%, Eldrazi Ramp 0.5%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.9%; Eldrazi-family decks ~20.0% combined (Eldrazi 3.1%, Eldrazi Tron 2.8%, Broodscale 1.5%+0.2%, Mono-Green Eldrazi 0.5%).

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #14 staple, 20% of decks; Emrakul #35 (16%), Sowing Mycospawn #26 (17%), Blade of the Bloodchief #49 (13%).

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #40 Legacy staple, ~12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 10)
sources.takeaway: Broodscale Bloodchief took 1st, 2nd and 3-4th of a 46-player Challenge; the winning list runs Eldrazi Temple and Emrakul.

sources.title: Eldrazi Ramp (Mono-Green Eldrazi Broodscale)
sources.takeaway: Goldfish's Eldrazi Ramp is the Broodscale combo deck: 4 Kozilek's Command, 4 Eldrazi Temple, 4 Mycospawn, ~4 Emrakul in every list.

sources.title: Unity League Finals - Nationals Germany 2026
sources.takeaway: Won by Living End; two Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8 (3-4th, 5-8th).

sources.title: Regional Championship - MIT Championship (Taipei)
sources.takeaway: Won by Rakdos Delirium; one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8 (5-8th).

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
